title: Form: swing events (2 new real clips, 2026-11-23)
instructions: Mark each moment for these two deliveries. These are the ground truth for the form timing + step detection (DECISIONS #4, 2026-11-23). The player opens near the engine's best guess — scrub to the exact frame and confirm/adjust. IMPORTANT: for the REAR clip, the engine is missing your EARLY approach steps — please scrub BACK from the slide to your FIRST step and set the step count to the true number. If a moment isn't clearly visible from this camera, press X (Not visible) rather than guessing.

events.label: Ball start (E2)
events.help: The ball first moves out of your setup hold (pushaway begins).

events.label: End of pushaway (E3)
events.help: The ball reaches the bottom/forward of the pushaway, about to swing back.

events.label: Top of swing (E4)
events.help: The ball at its highest point behind you.

events.label: Release (E7)
events.help: The ball leaves your hand at the bottom of the swing.

events.label: Slide stops (E8)
events.help: Your slide foot stops at the line.

fields.label: Approach steps (count ALL, incl. the first slow ones)
fields.help: e.g. 4 or 5 — scrub back to your first step
